name: L7 Attack-Pattern Signatures
description: Hand-curated L7 drop signatures for highest-accuracy reflection/amplification flood classes (DNS, NTP monlist, SSDP, CLDAP, memcached UDP). Not an IP feed: one pipe-separated signature per line, spec in docs/FEED-FORMATS.md. Loaded by OpenShield-XDP into the kernel l7_sig_map when auto_fetch.patterns_enabled is on.
